text: BookBreaker will be a sports statistics app for Mac and Windows.
BookBreaker will put a game count and a range beside every trend.
BookBreaker will offer last 5, last 10, last 20 and season views, with home or away and opponent filters.
BookBreaker will show how often similar past trends reached the number in later games, with a count and a Wilson range.
BookBreaker will need no account and will keep your history on your computer.
BookBreaker will work offline with the last stats file it has.
BookBreaker will cost $39 once, with 12 months of new games included. After that, new games will be an optional $19 a year.
Without the yearly update, BookBreaker will keep every stat and tool it already has. New games will stop arriving.
BookBreaker will cover player and team statistics for the NBA, NFL, MLB and NHL.
BookBreaker will let you type a number and read how often a player or team reached it, out of how many games.
The app will need no sign-in. Its full privacy details, including what a licence check sends, will be published before a download is available.
Player game logs for every league will come with BookBreaker. The NFL team pages, player pages and the free streak checker here use public NFL data.
BookBreaker will cost $39 once without later new-game updates.
BookBreaker will cost $39 once, then an optional $19 for each later year of new games.
